language_unit_dispositions.reason: a reference list has a fixed bibliographic form and carries no reusable prose move

global_organization_chain: summary gives each of the five tasks its sentence and closes on two virtues
introduction names the two controls and hands over the task list
two assumptions are each stated with a reason
five benefit functions are weighted into one monthly target
the lakes are drawn as one chain and the flow taken from a channel formula
each dam gets a rule that switches mode, with two gains retuned against a forecast
the rain and ice tests judge the rules against a no-dam baseline
the memo restates the work in the order it was built

main_argument_chains.claim: one monthly level per lake can serve the five groups of users at once
support_steps: each group is given its own scored function
the five are weighted by pairwise ranking and summed
the search returns a level per month, read against the historical mean
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: the dams are told to hold the monthly levels the search returns

main_argument_chains.claim: switching mode at the two dams holds the levels better than leaving them alone
support_steps: each dam is given a rule with two modes and a stated trigger
the rain test shows the dammed case ending lower than the no-dam case
the ice test is reported with its limit stated in the same breath
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: the board is offered the switched rules, with the fast-change limit named

warnings.warning: the freight score divides by the historical term, so a larger head raises the benefit, contradicting the sentence directly above it that calls the river level inversely proportional to the head
the channel formula is rewritten with the width both squared and to the two thirds, so the combined power is not the eight thirds of the next equation
the tuning score sums the squared level error over four lakes while the chain being steered has five

visualization_dispositions.analytical_purpose: show the whole basin as one directed chain, the flow running one way to the ocean
show the two switched controllers and the forecast module that retunes them
make the 2017 comparison visible, the recorded year against the best-level band
show the dammed case against the no-dam case after heavy rain
